blocks.text: As Disney+ heads into November, the streaming platform is beginning to phase out of its Halloween thrills and introduce a new slate of holiday favorites.

Among this month’s Christmas-centered additions are “A Bad Moms Christmas,” “A Christmas Story,” “The Polar Express,” “Four Christmases” and “National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation,” all of which will be available to stream on Hulu for bundle subscribers.
